title: HB610 (2017 Regular): Public Safety - Handgun Permit - Applicant Qualifications

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2017RS/bills/hb/hb0610f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed); no passage vote recorded. The bracketed words deleted from § 5–306(a)(6)(ii) are the 'good and substantial reason' requirement.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–306(a)(6)): based on an investigation, has not exhibited a propensity for violence or instability that may reasonably render the person’s possession of a handgun a danger to the person or to another.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–306(a)): Subject to subsection (c) of this section, the Secretary shall issue a permit within a reasonable time to a person who the Secretary finds: ... (existing law kept)
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–306(a)(6)(ii), struck by the bill in [brackets]): [; and (ii) has good and substantial reason to wear, carry, or transport a handgun, such as a finding that the permit is necessary as a reasonable precaution against apprehended danger].
